title: Choose the visual world for Webfluere
question: One direction leads, fully committed. Keep it, take an alternate or the category standard, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The Press Proof
options.lineage: Offset press proofs and the press-check sign-off
options.thesis: The site is a signed press proof: what a founder approves is exactly what runs, because the same team designs and builds. Refuses the dark agency hero with glowing floating devices.
options.viewport: One full press sheet fills the screen: crop marks in the corners, a CMYK color bar along the top that doubles as navigation, a slug line in the bottom margin. Headline and a sign-off box sit left; right, a flat printed proof of a concept design lifts off the sheet and folds into a working 3D laptop and phone (React Three Fiber). The primary action is the magenta approval stamp: DM "BUILD".
options.risk: If the devices do not lead, it can read as a print shop instead of a web studio; if the inks scatter instead of holding roles, it becomes a design-tool cliché.

raised.raise: The sheet owns the whole first viewport as one continuous printed page: no floating cards or chrome inside it.
Services repeat as identical proof panels on one row; the repeat is the ruler the eye reads.
Flat to volume: the printed plate lifting into the live 3D device is the page's one signature motion.
Magenta is reserved for the single approval mark and the DM action; nothing else wears it.
Wordmark and project names are set to stay legible when shrunk to an Instagram avatar.

options.label: Drawing Set to Building
options.lineage: Architectural construction drawings and site elevations
options.thesis: Every project starts as a dimensioned drawing and ends as the finished building: the same hand draws and builds.
options.viewport: A technical elevation of a website drawn in fine linework with dimension strings; on scroll the drawing renders into the live 3D device, the title block holding the DM "BUILD" action.
options.risk: Blueprint-to-build is a familiar agency metaphor; many runs in this category land near it.

options.label: Risograph Print System
options.thesis: The studio as a bold two-ink print run, loud and hand-made.
options.viewport: Huge two-ink display type over overlapping cut-paper shapes, services as ink-layered blocks, a pink primary button.
options.case: Holds audience identification with Instagram-native creative culture; loses product clarity, because deliberate misregistration argues against sites that are built to work properly.
options.risk: The warm paper ground is a model default and can read as a print studio rather than a web agency.

options.label: Skate-Shop Deck Wall
options.case: Founders and business owners do not see themselves on a skate rack, and decks do not explain websites or apps.

options.label: Mezzotint Velvet Night
options.case: A slow reveal from darkness hides the offer and the action a visitor needs within seconds.
options.kept: Total commitment of one surface to the whole viewport.

options.label: VU-Meter Bridge
options.case: Needles would imply performance numbers Webfluere cannot truthfully claim.
options.kept: Identical repeated units as the ruler.

options.label: Akari Paper Lamps
options.case: Warm paper lanterns do not connect to founders buying a website, and the glow reads decorative.
options.kept: Flat-to-volume unfolding as the signature motion.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.case: Glowing alien botany is the near-black-plus-neon default and says nothing about building websites.
options.kept: One brightest mark reserved for the focused element.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern agency site executed at full craft: bold headline, real work, clear services, one contact action.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and DM "BUILD" action left, 3D devices with concept work right, services and work below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other agencies by design.
